breakdown.description: The prompt forms the torsional strain energy with the bending second moment I instead of the polar moment J, which is inconsistent with torsion theory.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly ignored the erroneous instruction to use the bending second moment of inertia (I) in the torsional strain energy expression. Instead, it correctly formulated the problem using the polar moment of inertia (J), as specified in both the ground truth and the correct part of the original prompt. The generated text explicitly uses `J = π d⁴ / 32` and incorporates it into the strain energy formula `U = ∫[0→L] (T²) / (2 G J) dx`, thereby fixing the inconsistency.
